name: LoveSpark Quick Timer
summary: One-click focus timer with badge countdown. Presets or custom minutes. Built for ADHD brains. Free, lightweight.
detailed_description:
Set a timer in one click and get back to work.

ADHD brains struggle with time blindness. You sit down to work and suddenly two hours have passed — or you can't start because the task feels infinite. A simple timer externalizes time, making it visible and manageable. LoveSpark Quick Timer gives you instant access to preset and custom timers right from your toolbar, with a badge countdown so you always know how much time is left.

FEATURES

- Four preset timers: 5, 10, 15, and 25 minutes — one tap to start
- Custom timer input for any duration from 1 to 120 minutes
- Visual countdown ring with smooth progress animation
- Badge countdown on the extension icon — visible even when the popup is closed
- Completion notification when the timer finishes
- Cancel button to stop a timer early without judgment
- Track how many timers you've completed today and total
- Lightweight — runs in the background service worker with minimal resources
- 4 cozy themes: Retro Pink, Dark Noir, Warm Beige, Cool Slate
- Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support
- Respects prefers-reduced-motion for animation-sensitive users

HOW IT WORKS

1. Click the Quick Timer icon in your toolbar
2. Pick a preset (5, 10, 15, or 25 min) or type a custom duration
3. The timer starts immediately — a countdown ring shows your progress
4. The badge on the icon shows remaining minutes even when the popup is closed
5. When the timer completes, you get a notification

WHY LOVESPARK

LoveSpark is built by a neurodivergent developer who understands that the best timer is the one you actually use. Quick Timer has no complicated settings, no Pomodoro requirements, no technique you need to learn. Just pick a number and go. The badge countdown fights time blindness by keeping the remaining time visible at all times.

Every LoveSpark extension is free, open source, and privacy-first. We believe focus tools should reduce friction, not add it.

PRIVACY FIRST

LoveSpark Quick Timer stores all data locally in your browser. We collect zero data. No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No account required. Your data never leaves your device.

OPEN SOURCE

This extension is open source under the MIT license. View the code at github.com/Joona-t/lovespark-extensions/tree/main/productivity/lovespark-quick-timer.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
